text.p: Average yields at auctions of six-month, nine-month and 12-month Ukraine treasury bills slipped from the last sales, a central bank statement said on Wednesday.
Six-month bills edged down to 20.25 percent from 20.69 percent, nine-month bills eased to 28.54 percent from 28.73 percent, and 12-month bills fell to 28.28 percent from 31.68 percent.
The results of Tuesday's six-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 15.00 million UAH 12.00 million UAH
Amount sold 15.00 million UAH 12.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 13.62 million UAH 10.88 million UAH
The central bank sold 150,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for June 5.
The results of the nine-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 38.00 million UAH 30.00 million UAH
Amount sold 36.05 million UAH 8.38 million UAH
Actual amount raised 29.71 million UAH 6.899 million UAH
The central bank sold 360,477 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is scheduled for June 5.
The results of the 12-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 60.00 million UAH 45.00 million UAH
Amount sold 60.00 million UAH 45.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 46.80 million UAH 34.19 million UAH
The central bank sold 600,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is schedule for June 5.
